description.value: Pita Land Victoria is part of a Canadian halal Middle Eastern chain serving shawarma, falafel, kebabs, wraps, and rice plates rooted in family recipes originating in Toronto in 2003. Located in Victoria's Wilson Street area, it offers both dine-in and takeout with a broad menu that accommodates a range of dietary needs. The emphasis on fresh, unprocessed ingredients and generous portions makes it a practical stop for hungry cyclists.
